note: Fixed 2026-10-17 BEFORE any estimate was computed from collected data (collection was running on the user's PC; no estimate had been run or looked at). Supersedes v1 for a stricter estimator, never a looser one: (1) the WORSE of the buy and sell side is used per snapshot instead of their average; (2) a notional whose book walk ran out of visible depth in more than max_thin_share of snapshots is excluded from the impact fit as a whole (dropping only the thin snapshots would keep the cheap ones — selection bias), and the estimate is unusable when no fit notional is left; (3) snapshots with a stale book or stale closed kline, a duplicate timestamp, a symbol that does not match its folder or non-finite numbers are invalid; (4) collect_manifest.json is required and every input file must match its SHA-256 there. All v1 thresholds are unchanged. A change needs a new file (v3) with a reason.
